subject: Learning Methods
title: Building a Personal Reading System
description: Learn Building a Personal Reading System in one minute.

hook.text: Warren Buffett reads five hours a day. He credits his success not to intelligence but to a consistent reading system.

buildup.text: A reading system combines selection, engagement, note-taking, and review into an integrated habit that compounds.

discovery.text: The system need not be complex. Choose well, read actively, capture key ideas, and review periodically. Four steps.

twist.text: The bottleneck is almost never the reading itself. It is the review habit. Without review, the system leaks at the end.

climax.text: Design your system once and follow it for every book. Consistency turns reading from consumption into accumulation.

punchline.text: Systems beat willpower. Build once, follow always.

quiz.question: What is the most common bottleneck in a personal reading system?
options: The review habit that prevents captured ideas from fading
